description: Book a Tabflows demo for the person you are helping, at a startTime get_demo_availability listed for the same demo. demo picks which of the two demos tabflows.com/demo offers. "free-tools-demo", the default: a tour of the free Tabflows tools and a look at what we can automate. "automated-business-demo": the person brings one workflow, we build it live on their tools, then talk about a 2-week paid proof of concept. Tabflows emails them the invitation and a page for the call. Only call this after the person has chosen the time and agreed to Tabflows contacting them at that email and phone number; set consent to true only then, and never invent their details.

company.description: The person's clinic or company name

consent.description: Must be true: the person chose this time and agreed to Tabflows contacting them at this email and phone number.

phone.description: The person's phone number, as they give it. A number without + and a country code is read as a US number.

purpose.description: In the person's words: what they would like to see, or for the automated business demo, the workflow they want automated first. Never include patient names, dates of birth, medical details or any other patient information.

startTime.description: An ISO 8601 start time get_demo_availability listed for this demo

timezone.description: IANA timezone the times are read in, e.g. "America/New_York"

name: book_demo
title: Book a Tabflows demo
